scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r --sort run build && corepack pnpm -r --sort run test
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm --dir services/event-service exec vitest --config ../../vitest.e2e.config.ts run
scripts.test:migrations: corepack pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.migrations.config.ts run
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter './packages/**' --sort run build && corepack pnpm -r --sort run typecheck
